finding: Candidate map keyed by procedure/product/policy but not target; each procedure lookup combined multiple targets, then next(iter()) selected only the first target for scoring. Four-category declared package emitted passing-only scores and could not finish leader summary.
remedy: Preserve failed artifacts and receipt; use target-aware candidate keys in a separately versioned corrected package. No forecast changes or new fits required.
verification_scope: Independent structural source review and artifact census; did not invoke scorer or mutate parent files.
